title: Building the app stops running a second build and pasting its log into Info.plist
goal: Every app bundle build quietly runs an extra debug build and writes that build's log into the app's Info.plist, because of a comment in the build script. Each build the loop makes costs extra time, and the file is not valid XML to a strict reader.
notes: Reproduced 2026-11-07. Scripts/build-app.sh line 302, inside the unquoted PLIST heredoc, is a comment holding backticks round swift build, so bash runs it. dist/Photonz Probe.app/Contents/Info.plist lines 27 to 30 read 'plain [0/1] Planning build / Building for debugging... / [0/7] Write swift-version--58304C5D6DBC2206.txt / Build complete! (0.59s) dev runs behave the same. -->'. Python plistlib failed on it: 'ExpatError: not well-formed (invalid token): line 29, column 27' (the -- inside a comment). plutil and Launch Services tolerate it, so nothing has failed visibly. In the script since e50b69c4 (2026-06-20). Check before removing it that nothing leans on the debug build this happens to make. Serves the loop's build time, which every icon-svg task pays.
acceptance: A built bundle's Info.plist holds no build output and parses with a strict XML parser
Scripts/build-app.sh --probe runs swift build only the times it means to

log.note: digest 2026-11-07: epic icon-svg to unmanned-loop. This is the build, not an icon, and it should not jump the queue as focus work. Confirmed: plistlib on the probe's Info.plist still fails, not well-formed at line 29, column 27.
